releaseNotes: Adds compact Notes status pills to the right of the Notes title: TEXT + INK, AUTOSAVE and SYNC READY
SYNC is intentionally future-ready and can later display Synchronisiert, Offline or Sync Fehler from LuMa Sync state
Keeps the header compact and E-Ink friendly without adding another information card below Notes
Keeps the confirmed 0.12.32 Notes workspace and editor behavior unchanged
